label: Observed Day-60 EPSS >= 0.1; null is unknown, never negative
interpretation: Retrospective score category, not historical prediction, catalogue membership or observed exploitation.
scope: Reddit FC01 Run 1 only: three existing evidence-group-disjoint chronological inner folds of original training CVEs; all assessment target dates under EPSS v2.
predictors: Parent fold-fitted CVSS/reference fields and, for pooled_D only, the frozen standalone D TOKEN mean. No EPSS of any date, targets, regression predictions, catalogue fields or IDs.
operating_point: Largest selection probability cutoff attaining maximum selection F1; never used for AP or budget rankings.
budget: Top ceil(5 percent of all matched out-of-fold CVEs) per system; exact probability ties broken by CVE ID. Also report each fold descriptively.

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%, conditional on these fits; rerank at the same fractional budget in every draw

progression: Require support, and lower bounds above zero for BOTH primary direct-minus-regression differences: AP and recall at 5 percent. Otherwise stop; secondary results cannot override. Passing permits a separate TPG proposal only.
limitations: Prior regression outcomes already inspected. This compares two complete systems, not the isolated causal effect of the objective. No separate forecast, old-dataset fit, official holdout or TPG release.
